calls.title: Alexey L and James Shannon
calls.summary: The team discussed selecting an experimentation platform, ultimately shortlisting GrowthBook for its usability, flexibility, and moderate pricing. They aim to run multiple simultaneous tests across websites, mobile apps, and browser extensions with sophisticated audience segmentation and traffic management. Starting with GrowthBook’s Pro plan on WordPress, they will gradually enable marketing teams to create experiments independently. Pricing will shift to an event-based model soon, and an Enterprise tier may be trialed for enhanced support. User tracking through hashing and linking anonymous identifiers to account IDs is essential for accurate analysis. The goal is to launch the platform within a month, supported by a free proof of concept to validate the platform's value.
calls.keywords: A/B testing, GrowthBook, Pro vs Enterprise, user tracking, Visual Editor, pricing model
